examples.en:
Abu Dib. One day Abu Dib was sitting by himself in the winter. He started stealing chickens little by little and eating. He would take his sweet time eating; goodness, five chickens all by himself! And anyone who sees him would say “that guy couldn't even eat a piece of bread” because he’s so skinny — and short, short like a Japanese person.

examples.en:
Francis had pruned the vines before he went up to the šīr [the rocky face of the mountain], and there was a single vine near his head that his turban draped itself over. Tansa Nehme came by and walked past him, stepped on the vine, knocked the turban off, and cried: Mom—Farfūra! Look, Francis has risen! and then Romanos Chidiac came to tell him off, saying: You nutcase! A dead man risen? Look at you, coming to scare us at this hour... And then the priest arrived, with everyone from the village there with him. He blessed him with prayer and incense, and we picked him [Francis] up and went up to the village, where a few men stayed with him to keep watch overnight. The next day at 10:00 we held his funeral and took him to the cemetery.
[original: Fransis avait émondé la treille avant de monter au šīr. Un sarment se trouva près de sa tête, sur ce sarment se posa le petit turban. Ṭansa Naʿmé passa à côté et marcha sur le sarment. Le petit turban se redressa. Il s'écria: « O ma mère Farfūra, je t'en prie, Fransis s'est levé! » et puis Romanos Chidiac se mit à lui dire: « Eh donc! fou! le mort pourrait se lever! Tu viens nous faire peur pendant cette nuit! » Et puis le Curé arriva et le peuple avec lui. Il lui fit les prières, les bénédictions d'encens et nous l'avons emporté et nous sommes montés au village. Quelques personnes restèrent pour le veiller. Le lendemain à 10 h., nous avons fait ses funérailles et nous l'avons porté au cimetière.]

ما انت دايرة باليانِس أربع وعشرين ساعة
أعملك كاسة أنيسون تروِّق أعصابك
زوري حماتك بشكل يومي
يوه! أنت مازهقتش نق!
